lines.en: label harukanightgen2:
scene harukanightgen2
I decide to keep Haruka company at her place for the night.
lines.zh: 我决定晚上去 Haruka 家陪陪她。

lines.en: I know how easily she gets lonely and I get along with her rather well, so it's an easy decision for me to make.
lines.zh: 我知道她有多容易感到孤单，而且我和她也相当合得来，所以这个决定并不难做。

lines.en: Nothing interesting happens. We just sort of chill on her couch and order a pizza.
lines.zh: 没发生什么有趣的事。我们就在她家沙发上窝着，叫了份披萨。

lines.en: And while nights like this aren't exactly going to go down in history as glorious or amazing moments, they're always welcome.
lines.zh: 虽说这样的夜晚不会作为什么辉煌或美妙的时刻载入史册，但它们永远受人欢迎。

lines.en: Sometimes, all people need is to relax for a little while and forget about their obligations.
lines.zh: 有时候，人们需要的只是放松一会儿，把那些该尽的责任暂时忘掉。

lines.en: For Haruka, that probably means abandoning thoughts of the cafe for the night.
lines.zh: 对 Haruka 来说，那大概意味着今晚把咖啡馆的事抛到脑后。

lines.en: And for me, I guess it's something along the lines of...
lines.zh: 而对我来说，大概是类似于……

lines.en: if bonus == True:
Not worrying about who is going to find out that I'm having sex with some of the class?
lines.zh: 不去担心谁会发现我在和班上的一些人上床？

lines.en: But hey, another cool thing about Haruka is that I'm pretty sure I could flat out tell her I'm doing that and she'd get just as excited about it as I am.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，Haruka 还有个很棒的地方——我敢肯定，就算我直截了当告诉她我在干这种事，她也会和我一样兴奋。

lines.en: else:
: Oh no. I forgot to pay the water bill.
: Oh no.
scene black
We watch a few episodes of some cooking show together and, after it gets to be a little late, I decide to head back.
lines.zh: 我们一起看了几集烹饪节目，等天色有点晚了，我便决定回去了。

lines.en: Haruka offers to let me crash on the couch (Probably to help quell her unending desire for company) but I already have Ami texting me to come home so I have to refuse.
lines.zh: Haruka 提出让我在沙发上凑合一晚（大概是为了缓解她那永远填不满的陪伴欲），但 Ami 已经在发短信催我回家，所以我只能拒绝。

lines.en: She understands and says goodbye to me as I put my shoes back on.
lines.zh: 她表示理解，在我穿鞋时和我道别。

lines.en: Out of the corner of my eye, I see her open her arms as if she's going to come hug me, but she quickly backs off and I decide to not bring any attention to it.
lines.zh: 余光里，我看到她张开双臂、像是要过来抱我，但很快又退了回去，而我决定不去点破。

lines.en: Then, just like most other nights, I walk back out into the cold with my hands in my pockets.
lines.zh: 然后，就像其他大多数夜晚一样，我双手插兜，走回外面的寒冷里。
